title: Blackstone Carne Asada with Taco Seasoning
description: Tender skirt steak with orange, garlic, smoked paprika, and a light touch of taco seasoning, seared on the Blackstone and finished with fresh lime.
totalTime: About 1½–3½ hours including marinating and resting
ingredients: 12–15 g garlic, finely minced or grated
12–18 g taco seasoning, adjusted to its saltiness
Salt only if needed after tasting the taco seasoning
15–25 g freshly squeezed lime juice, for finishing
steps: Mix the orange juice, oil, garlic, taco seasoning, smoked paprika, black pepper, and lime zest. Coat the steak and refrigerate for 1–3 hours.
Heat the Blackstone until very hot. Lift the steak from the marinade and let excess liquid drip off so it sears well.
Sear the steak whole for about 2–4 minutes per side, depending on thickness. For medium rare, remove at 125–130°F / 52–54°C; cook a little longer if preferred.
Rest the steak for 5–10 minutes. Slice thinly against the grain, then chop into taco sized pieces. For crisp edges, return the chopped steak to the hot griddle for 30–60 seconds.
Finish with the fresh lime juice. Taste before adding salt, since taco seasoning can already be salty.
notes: This recreates the tailgate version David reported as especially tender and flavorful: heavy on smoked paprika and garlic, with orange in the marinade, lighter taco seasoning and salt, and lime after cooking. Serve with sautéed peppers and onions and tortillas browned on the Blackstone. Seasoning weights are reconstructed estimates because the original batch was not weighed.
